ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

WEIGHT RESTRICTIONS (FEDERAL ROADS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 70(1)

of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Weight Restrictions (Federal Roads)

(Amendment) Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 31 October 2018.

Substitution of First Schedule
